```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s] : Finite ↑(f.seq s) := by
  let f' : α → β := ⟨⟩
  let s' : Set α := s
  haveI : Finite ↑(s' ×ˢ ↑f) := Finite.Set.finite_prod s' ↑f
  exact Finite.Set.finite_image2 (fun a b => (b : α → β) a) s' ↑f
```
